prerequisites: The module 'Grundlagen der Programmierung 1' was already attended and the competencies in procedural programming acquired there are present.

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to state and explain the essential features of an object-oriented programming language.
Students are able to use the basic programming constructs of Java in concrete programs.
Students are able to explain the most important functions of a modern development environment and use them for program creation.
Students are able to explain the problem of proving the correctness of a program and describe and apply a systematic testing methodology to reduce errors.
Students are able to use the GIT tool to manage their own source code on their own PC and synchronize its database with a repository in the cloud.
Students are able to successfully demonstrate the practical application of the learned content in a medium-sized programming task (practical course).
Students are able to apply object-oriented programming techniques and create a complete application with an interactive graphical user interface.

syllabus_topics: Advanced language concepts: Interfaces, Exceptions, Packages
Graphical user interfaces, handling asynchronous events
Implementation of a Media Player with a graphical interface (Practical Course)
assessment_rules: Successful completion of the practical course (7.2) is a prerequisite for participation in the written examination (7.1). In the practical course, several testates (programming tasks in Java) must be acquired by presenting finished solutions and answering questions about the solution concept and program. Five tasks must be completed on time for the certificate of achievement to be considered fulfilled.
